title: Nurse or midwife registration and employment
summary: A structured route from eligibility and evidence preparation through UK professional registration and employer recruitment.
steps: Complete the NMC assessment/Test of Competence route where required
Complete health, character and registration steps
Search and apply to eligible employers
Complete the appropriate immigration route after a suitable offer

title: Study in the UK
authority: UK institution + UK Visas and Immigration
summary: Select an institution and programme, secure admission, then complete the appropriate student immigration requirements.
steps: Prepare transcripts, references and funding evidence
Plan professional registration separately if you intend to practise

title: Internationally qualified nurse pathway
authority: Nursing Council of New Zealand + employer
summary: Review the IQN route, complete document verification and Council requirements, then use legitimate employer pathways.
steps: Meet competence, English and fitness requirements where applicable
Use Health NZ or another legitimate employer pathway

title: Study in New Zealand
summary: Admission and student visa steps are distinct from professional registration if you intend to practise after study.
steps: Apply for the appropriate student visa

title: Internationally educated nurse registration pathway
summary: Canadian nursing registration is provincial/territorial. Credential assessment and regulator requirements must be checked for the chosen province.
steps: Complete regulator-specific examination or competence requirements

title: Study in Canada
summary: Admission, study permit and future professional licensing are separate steps.
steps: Plan future registration or licensure separately

title: Internationally qualified nurse or midwife pathway
authority: Ahpra + Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia
summary: The IQNM pathway includes assessment steps and registration standards before employment as a registered practitioner.
steps: Apply to legitimate employers and then complete immigration steps

title: Study in Australia
authority: Australian institution + Department of Home Affairs
summary: Choose a CRICOS-registered programme and complete admission and student-visa requirements.
steps: Review Genuine Student and evidence requirements
Apply for the appropriate student visa

title: Registered nurse employment and state licensure
authority: State board of nursing + relevant credentialing bodies
summary: Nursing regulation is state-based. Requirements can include credential evaluation, English evidence, NCLEX-RN and state-specific requirements.
steps: Read the state board's internationally educated nurse requirements
Complete NCLEX-RN and state licensing requirements
Use legitimate employer and immigration pathways

title: Study in the United States
summary: Admission and immigration are separate decisions; nursing practice also remains subject to state regulation.
